description: This file defines the SqlParser class which provides methods for parsing and executing SQL scripts, specifically tailored for different database types like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL. It includes functions for processing SQL files, filtering comments, and executing SQL commands via a database connection.

classes.name: SqlParser
classes.description: A class for parsing and executing SQL scripts with support for multiple database types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection, type, and table prefix.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads a SQL script file, filters and processes its contents, and executes the SQL statements.

methods.name: only_good_mysql
methods.description: Filters out comments from SQL lines specific to MySQL.

methods.name: only_good_sql
methods.description: Filters out comments and blank lines from SQL input based on comment character.
